# Journey Mental Health Center

> > Journey Mental Health Center provides comprehensive mental health services in Madison and Dane County, Wisconsin, including crisis intervention, therapy, and culturally-specific care.

Journey Mental Health Center offers a wide continuum of care including 24/7 crisis services, outpatient therapy (CBT, DBT, ACT), and specialized programs like Clinica Latina for Spanish-speaking clients and GROW CCS for youth. The organization accepts Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans including Quartz Health Solutions and Dean Health Plan.

## Key Topics

- 24/7 Crisis Services
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Acceptance & Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- Clinica Latina
- GROW CCS
- Ujima
- Culturally-Specific Care
- Telehealth Services
- Dane County Mental Health
- Medicare & Medicaid
- Quartz Health Solutions
- Dean Health Plan
- Trauma-Informed Care
- LGBTQ+ Resources
